title: Medical Tourism Services in India
subtitle: Coordinated support for every step of your medical journey in India — from specialist consultations to post-treatment follow-up.
freeNoticeHeading: Ready to Explore Medical Treatment in India?
freeNotice: Tell us about your condition. Share your medical reports and let Panacea Medcare help you explore suitable specialists, hospitals, treatment options and indicative costs before you travel.

medicalOpinion.title: 1. Specialist Doctor Consultation
medicalOpinion.description: Not sure which specialist you need? Connect with suitable doctors in India based on your medical reports, condition and treatment requirements before travelling for medical care.

caseManagement.title: 2. Hospital Selection in India
caseManagement.description: Choosing the right hospital matters. Get access to leading hospitals in India based on your treatment needs, specialty, facilities, location and international patient support.

telemedicine.title: 3. Medical Second Opinion
telemedicine.description: Need clarity before making a major treatment decision? Get your medical reports reviewed and coordinated with suitable specialists in India for an informed second medical opinion.

preTravelConsult.title: 4. Medical Report Evaluation
preTravelConsult.description: Send your medical reports, scans and previous treatment records for preliminary evaluation and specialist coordination, helping identify suitable treatment pathways before you travel to India.

visaSupport.title: 5. Medical Visa Assistance
visaSupport.description: Medical travel involves paperwork, documentation and planning. Get coordinated assistance with the medical visa process and supporting hospital documentation for your treatment journey in India.

currencyExchange.title: 6. Medical Treatment Cost Estimate
currencyExchange.description: Worried about unexpected treatment expenses? Get indicative medical treatment cost estimates from suitable hospitals in India, helping you plan your healthcare journey with greater financial clarity.

interpreters.title: 7. Interpreter & Patient Support
interpreters.description: Language barriers shouldn't make healthcare more difficult. Access interpreter and international patient support where available, helping you communicate more comfortably with doctors, hospitals and care teams.

transportation.title: 8. Airport Pickup & Transfers
transportation.description: Arriving in India shouldn't add to your stress. Get coordinated airport pickup and transportation support between the airport, hotel and hospital throughout your medical journey.

accommodation.title: 9. Accommodation Assistance
accommodation.description: Need comfortable accommodation close to your hospital? Get assistance finding suitable hotels and stays based on your treatment location, duration, convenience and international patient requirements.

admissionSupport.title: 10. Hospital Admission Assistance
admissionSupport.description: Hospital admission can feel complicated when you're travelling internationally. Receive dedicated coordination with documentation, appointments and admission procedures to make your arrival and treatment smoother.

nursingCare.title: 11. Post-Treatment & Follow-Up Support
nursingCare.description: Your medical journey doesn't end after discharge. Get continued coordination for follow-up consultations, medical records and communication with healthcare providers after returning home.

flexiblePayment.title: 12. Hospital Appointment Coordination
flexiblePayment.description: Avoid the hassle of managing appointments from another country. Get consultations and hospital appointments coordinated around your treatment plan, medical reports and travel schedule.

patientPortal.title: 13. AI-Powered Medical Pre-Screening
patientPortal.description: Not sure where to begin? Use AI-powered medical pre-screening to understand potential specialties, treatment pathways and indicative costs before connecting with healthcare professionals in India.
